usedFor: gate keeps entries with a status, and Microsoft Excel logs each “Gate Status Changed” through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “Gate Status Changed” in gate, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every status change becomes a row, leaving a history table you can filter by date or entry.

watchOut: “Gate Status Changed” is polling, so quick back to back changes may be logged after a short delay.
